notes.heading: Alcohol sales permit
items: The permit covers only the area marked on the final site plan, up to 7,764 sq ft.
Alcohol may be sold only in restaurants that get at least 60% of gross revenue from food, and the bookkeeping records must be open to the Town for inspection.
Signs may not advertise alcohol sales or use the words "bar" or "tavern".

If the property is not used for the permit's purpose within a year of the ordinance, or the alcohol license is revoked, terminated or cancelled, the City Council may hold hearings on changing the zoning and repealing the permit.

notes.heading: Landscaping and screening
items: At least 18% of the gross lot area must be landscaped.
A street landscape buffer of variable width and landscaping around the parking lot must follow the landscape plan.
Outside storage of wood and smoker accessory materials must be screened from the right-of-way and adjacent properties by building facade elements, fences or screening walls.

curtisNotes: Loro's PD builds on the legacy Local Retail (LR) district, which CL replaced, so some uses and dimensions may differ from the original rules.
